answer: Because the vault ledger attributes every share, the vertex audit shows the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 75% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, and therefore it pays the garden fee twice and still divides one payout. That is 31 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
